steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.

Provide the required event title.
Apply the first available questionnaire template.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the event-wise or stage-wise clauses and mark them mandatory; no dedicated catalog step exposes this editor.
Add one available QA test vendor for the event.
Commit the 30-minute schedule required before publishing.
Publish the configured single-stage RFP.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal session.
Open the event's RFP questionnaire and terms as the vendor.

args.need: accept both mandatory terms, complete the RFP questionnaire, and submit the vendor response

Assert that the vendor response is shown as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
